submitted.rationale: XRD shows rutile CrSbO4-type peaks (Q≈1.93, 2.48) across the line. Cr-rich films (idx 8) also show a Cr2O3-like secondary peak (Q≈2.55), and Sb-rich films show a Sb-oxide peak (Q≈2.72). Among the three EQE measurements, the Sb-rich rutile films performed best: idx 22 had 0.0155%, idx 17 had 0.0151% and the near-stoichiometric idx 12 had 0.0011%. Idx 22 is the highest measured.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE about 14x lower than the Sb-rich films
XRD shows a Cr2O3-like secondary phase; the trend in Cr-rich films points to low EQE
